note: 離岸風電的組裝出港、製造與運維港口，2026 年 9 月人工整理、2026 年 10 月補入中國、韓國、菲律賓、歐洲與美國的港口，並補齊歐洲主要離岸風場的安裝港與運維港；每個港口附出處，服務過的風場只列有出處佐證的。

Offshore wind marshalling, manufacturing and O&M ports compiled by hand in Sep 2026 and extended in Oct 2026 (China, Korea, the Philippines, Europe, US; installation and O&M ports of the main European offshore farms); each port lists its sources, and farms served are only those a source ties to the port.

roles.foundation: 水下基礎製造 / foundation fabrication

ports.name: Port of Hastings
ports.en: Victoria's planned Renewable Energy Terminal on the 25 ha Old Tyabb Reclamation Area, to receive, store and assemble offshore wind components; construction could start in 2027 if approved.
ports.zhNote: 維多利亞州規劃在 25 公頃的 Old Tyabb 填海區興建再生能源碼頭，接收、儲放及組裝離岸風機組件；若獲核准最快 2027 年動工。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Old Tyabb Reclamation Area (planned terminal site), about 2.6 km north-east of Hastings between Long Island Point jetty and BlueScope's wharves, Western Port.

ports.name: Port Oostende (REBO heavy-weight terminal)
ports.en: REBO's 800 m heavy-weight quay is a construction base where turbine components are assembled for offshore wind farms, and every Belgian North Sea wind farm (399 turbines) is maintained from Oostende.
ports.zhNote: REBO 800 公尺重件碼頭是離岸風場風機組件的組裝施工基地，比利時北海所有風場（399 部風機）皆由奧斯坦德負責運維。
ports.coordNote: Heavy-load quay on the east bank (Oosteroever) of Oostende harbour (OSM man_made=quay); the REBO berth itself is not tagged

ports.name: Bremerhaven (ABC-Halbinsel / Container Terminal)
ports.en: Base port for Global Tech I (BLG offshore terminal, ABC peninsula) and, from 2011, Nordsee Ost (Container Terminal); the public Labradorhafen heavy-load terminal has a 1,132 m quay.
ports.zhNote: 曾為 Global Tech I（ABC 半島離岸碼頭）與 Nordsee Ost（2011 年起）的施工基地港；公共重件碼頭 Labradorhafen 岸線長 1,132 公尺。
ports.coordNote: ABC peninsula (BLG offshore terminal area) in Bremerhaven's overseas port (OSM locality node)

ports.name: Cuxhaven (Offshore Base / Siemens Gamesa nacelle plant)
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's offshore nacelle plant (opened 2018) sits on the quay; the offshore base served as base port for Nordsee One and assembled suction-bucket jackets for Borkum Riffgrund 2.
ports.zhNote: 西門子歌美颯離岸機艙廠（2018 年啟用）緊鄰碼頭；離岸基地曾是 Nordsee One 的施工基地港，並為 Borkum Riffgrund 2 組裝吸力桶式套管式基礎。
ports.coordNote: Offshore-base quay on the Elbe in front of the Siemens Gamesa nacelle plant, Cuxhaven (OSM works polygon and coastline)

ports.name: Mukran Port (Sassnitz, Rügen)
ports.en: Baltic Sea base port: its Offshore Terminal South supported construction of EnBW Baltic 2, Wikinger and Arkona, and the port offers long-term service bases.
ports.zhNote: 波羅的海的離岸風電基地港：南側離岸碼頭曾支援 EnBW Baltic 2、Wikinger 與 Arkona 施工，並提供長期服務基地。
ports.coordNote: Southern berths (LP 1–3) of Mukran Port where the Offshore Terminal South lies; the terminal is not tagged individually in OSM

ports.name: Port of Rostock (EEW SPC monopile plant)
ports.en: EEW SPC has made monopiles at the port since 2008 (over 2,600, up to 12 m diameter) with direct quay access; monopiles for Hornsea One, Kriegers Flak and half of Gemini came from Rostock.
ports.zhNote: EEW SPC 自 2008 年起在港區生產單樁（逾 2,600 支、直徑達 12 公尺）並可直接上船；Hornsea 1、Kriegers Flak 與 Gemini 半數單樁來自羅斯托克。
ports.coordNote: Rostock overseas port (Überseehafen) main basin; the EEW SPC plant with its own quay is in the port but was not located individually

ports.name: Port Esbjerg (Østhavn)
ports.en: Europe's leading offshore wind port: 23.6 GW shipped since 2001 (about 4/5 of Europe's capacity), incl. Horns Rev 1–2, DanTysk, Sandbank, Butendiek and UK farms; also a service base.
ports.zhNote: 歐洲首要離岸風電港：2001 年起出貨 23.6 GW（約歐洲裝置量五分之四），含 Horns Rev、DanTysk 等風場，亦為運維基地。
ports.coordNote: Virgokaj in the East Harbour (Østhavn), Port Esbjerg's offshore wind area (OSM quay name)

ports.name: Port of Grenaa
ports.en: Installation base for the Anholt offshore wind farm and pre-assembly/O&M port on the Kattegat; the TetraSpar floating demonstrator was assembled here.
ports.zhNote: Anholt 離岸風場的安裝基地，卡特加特海峽的預組裝與運維港；TetraSpar 浮動式示範機組亦在此組裝。
ports.coordNote: Kattegatkajen in Grenaa's North Harbour (OSM quay name); the sources do not name the exact Anholt quay

ports.name: Port of Rønne (Bornholm)
ports.en: Baltic installation port: turbines for Kriegers Flak were prepared here and loaded four at a time; it also handled Arcadis Ost 1, Baltic Eagle and Baltic Power.
ports.zhNote: 波羅的海安裝港：Kriegers Flak 風機在此預組裝、每趟裝載 4 部出海；亦處理 Arcadis Ost 1、Baltic Eagle 與 Baltic Power。
ports.coordNote: South harbour quays (Kulkajen/Skærvekajen area) of Rønne Havn; the exact offshore-wind quay is not named in the sources

ports.name: Ferrol / Fene (Navantia–Windar yard)
ports.en: Navantia's Fene shipyard, in partnership with Windar, builds monopiles (up to 12 m diameter) and jackets; Navantia Seanergies signed its first offshore wind contract in Dec 2014.
ports.zhNote: Navantia 的 Fene 船廠與 Windar 合作製造單樁（直徑達 12 公尺）與套管式基礎；Navantia Seanergies 於 2014 年 12 月簽下首份離岸風電合約。
ports.coordNote: Windar Offshore Galicia position given by Windar (Perlío pier beside the Navantia Fene shipyard)

ports.name: Port of Avilés (Windar Offshore)
ports.en: Windar has expanded its Avilés plants for offshore wind foundations since 2012; transition pieces are made at its Tadarsa Eólica T4 plant in Avilés.
ports.zhNote: Windar 自 2012 年起擴充 Avilés 廠區的離岸風電基礎產能，轉接段在 Avilés 的 Tadarsa Eólica T4 廠製造。
ports.coordNote: Windar Offshore T1 plant position given by Windar, in the Avilés port area on the ría

ports.name: Port of Bilbao (Haizea Wind, Muelle AZ-2)
ports.en: Haizea Wind's plant on the Bilbao outer harbour makes monopiles; the first Hornsea 3 monopiles (about 90 m, 1,670 t) shipped from Bilbao to Teesside in early 2026.
ports.zhNote: Haizea Wind 位於畢爾包外港的工廠生產單樁；Hornsea 3 首批單樁（約 90 公尺、1,670 噸）於 2026 年初由畢爾包運往英國 Teesworks。
ports.coordNote: Muelle AZ-2 quay in front of the Haizea Wind plant, Port of Bilbao outer harbour, Zierbena (OSM)

ports.name: Cherbourg (Quai des Flamands)
ports.en: Logistics hub where Fécamp's turbine components (blades, nacelles, tower sections) were stored from March 2023 before loading onto the installation vessel.
ports.zhNote: Fécamp 風場的風機組件（葉片、機艙、塔架段）自 2023 年 3 月起在瑟堡物流中心儲放，再裝上安裝船出海。
ports.coordNote: Quai des Flamands deep-water quay, Cherbourg (OSM quay); exact Fécamp laydown area not named in the source

ports.name: Le Havre (Quai de Bougainville)
ports.en: The 71 concrete gravity-based foundations (about 5,000 t each) for the Fécamp offshore wind farm were built in Le Havre from December 2020.
ports.zhNote: Fécamp 離岸風場的 71 座混凝土重力式基礎（每座約 5,000 噸）自 2020 年 12 月起在勒哈佛港建造。
ports.coordNote: Quai de Bougainville, Port of Le Havre (OSM quay); French Wikipedia places the Fécamp foundation yard at Bougainville

ports.name: Nantes Saint-Nazaire Port (Montoir, GE nacelle plant)
ports.en: GE's offshore nacelle and generator plant on the port opened in Dec 2014; the Saint-Nazaire wind farm was pre-assembled and installed from the port. A floating-wind assembly quay (Éole) is planned.
ports.zhNote: GE 離岸機艙與發電機工廠位於港區（2014 年 12 月啟用）；聖納澤爾風場風機由本港預組裝出海，並規劃浮動式風機組裝碼頭（Éole）。
ports.coordNote: Montoir terminal quay beside the GE (ex-Alstom) offshore nacelle/generator plant (OSM works and pier)

ports.name: Able Seaton Port (Hartlepool)
ports.en: Installation base for Hornsea One foundations (2018), Vestas turbine marshalling for Seagreen, and GE Haliade-X pre-assembly port for Dogger Bank A, B and C.
ports.zhNote: Hornsea 1 水下基礎安裝基地（2018），Seagreen 的 Vestas 風機組裝港，也是 Dogger Bank A、B、C 的 GE 風機預組裝港。
farms: Dogger Bank wind farm · B, C
ports.coordNote: Able UK quay frontage on the Seaton Channel, River Tees, east of the TERRC dry dock (OSM Able UK works / coastline)

ports.name: Belfast Harbour D1 Offshore Wind Terminal
ports.zh: 貝爾法斯特港 D1 碼頭
ports.en: UK's first purpose-built offshore wind terminal (2013): pre-assembly for West of Duddon Sands, Walney Extension and Burbo Bank Extension; leased for Mona and Morgan from 2028.
ports.zhNote: 英國首座離岸風電專用碼頭（2013），曾為 West of Duddon Sands、Walney Extension 等預組裝港；2028 年起供 Mona、Morgan 使用。
ports.coordNote: D1 quay on the County Down (east) side of Belfast Harbour, currently also the cruise berth (OSM coastline / cruise terminal)

ports.name: Great Yarmouth (Outer Harbour and river port)
ports.en: Pre-assembly/load-out port for Galloper (2017) and East Anglia ONE (2019–20); installation base for Sheringham Shoal and Lincs; O&M bases for Dudgeon, Sheringham Shoal and Scroby Sands.
ports.zhNote: Galloper、East Anglia ONE 的預組裝出港港口，Sheringham Shoal、Lincs 的安裝基地，並有 Dudgeon 等風場運維基地。
ports.coordNote: West quay of the Great Yarmouth Outer Harbour (OSM coastline); O&M bases are on the river harbour

ports.name: Green Port Hull (Alexandra Dock)
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's offshore blade factory (opened Dec 2016) and turbine load-out quay; installation base for Dudgeon, Hornsea One and Two, and Sofia.
ports.zhNote: 西門子歌美颯離岸風機葉片工廠（2016 年 12 月啟用）與風機出貨碼頭，為 Dudgeon、Hornsea 1、2 及 Sofia 的組裝港。
ports.coordNote: Siemens Gamesa riverside quay on the Humber at the south edge of the Alexandra Dock factory site (OSM works polygon/coastline)

ports.name: Montrose Port (South Quay)
ports.en: Operations and maintenance base for Seagreen (vessel operations from early 2022); an O&M base for Inch Cape has been under construction at the port since 2025.
ports.zhNote: Seagreen 離岸風場的運維基地（2022 年初起運作）；Inch Cape 的運維基地自 2025 年起於港內興建。
ports.coordNote: South Quay on the south bank of the River South Esk (Rossie Island side), where the Seagreen O&M base was built (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Aberdeen (North Harbour)
ports.en: North Harbour is the O&M base for the Aberdeen Offshore Wind Farm (EOWDC) and the Kincardine floating wind farm; the new South Harbour targets floating-wind integration.
ports.zhNote: 北港為亞伯丁離岸風場（EOWDC）與 Kincardine 浮動式風場的運維基地；新建南港鎖定浮動式風機整合作業。
ports.coordNote: North Harbour main basin (Victoria Dock); the individual O&M berths were not identified

ports.name: Port of Barrow (Ørsted West Coast Hub)
ports.en: Ørsted's West Coast Hub at the Port of Barrow runs O&M for Barrow, Walney 1&2, West of Duddon Sands and Walney Extension (about 1.5 GW).
ports.zhNote: Ørsted 西岸中心位於巴羅港，負責 Barrow、Walney 1&2、West of Duddon Sands 與 Walney Extension（約 1.5 GW）的運維。
ports.coordNote: Ramsden Dock, Port of Barrow (main basin); the exact O&M pontoon was not identified

ports.name: Port of Grimsby (Royal Dock O&M hubs)
ports.en: Large offshore wind O&M cluster: Ørsted's East Coast Hub (Hornsea 1–2, Race Bank, Lincs, Westermost Rough) and RWE's Grimsby Hub (Triton Knoll, Sofia; opened July 2025).
ports.zhNote: 大型運維聚落：Ørsted 東岸中心（Hornsea 1–2、Race Bank 等）與 RWE 格林斯比中心（Triton Knoll、Sofia，2025 年啟用）。
ports.coordNote: Ørsted East Coast Hub on the north-east side of Grimsby's Royal Dock (OSM); RWE's Grimsby Hub is also on the Royal Dock

ports.name: Port of Lowestoft (Hamilton Dock)
ports.en: O&M port for SSE's Greater Gabbard (since 2012) and ScottishPower Renewables' East Anglia ONE (30-year deal, base at Hamilton Dock); supported Galloper construction.
ports.zhNote: SSE Greater Gabbard（2012 年起）與 East Anglia ONE（Hamilton 船塢，30 年合約）的運維港，也曾支援 Galloper 施工。
ports.coordNote: Hamilton Dock, beside which ScottishPower Renewables' East Anglia O&M base sits (OSM dock); SSE's Greater Gabbard base is elsewhere in the port

ports.name: Port of Mostyn
ports.en: Construction port for seven Irish Sea wind farms incl. North Hoyle, Rhyl Flats, Gwynt y Môr, Burbo Bank, Robin Rigg and Walney 1&2; RWE's O&M hub for its Welsh farms.
ports.zhNote: 曾是 North Hoyle、Rhyl Flats、Gwynt y Môr、Burbo Bank 等七座愛爾蘭海風場的施工港，也是 RWE 威爾斯風場的運維中心。
ports.coordNote: River berth on the Dee estuary frontage of the Port of Mostyn (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Nigg (Cromarty Firth)
ports.en: Turbine pre-assembly port for Beatrice (2018), Moray East (2021) and Moray West, and foundation marshalling for Seagreen (jackets) and Moray West (transition pieces).
ports.zhNote: Beatrice（2018）、Moray East（2021）、Moray West 的風機預組裝港，也是 Seagreen 套管式基礎與 Moray West 轉接段的儲運港。
ports.coordNote: South-facing quay west of the Nigg dry dock, Nigg Energy Park (OSM coastline)

ports.name: Port of Tyne (Dogger Bank O&M base)
ports.en: Home of the Dogger Bank Wind Farm operations and maintenance base and control room, officially opened in March 2023 and run by Equinor for all phases.
ports.zhNote: Dogger Bank 離岸風場的運維基地與控制中心，2023 年 3 月正式啟用，由 Equinor 負責營運各期風場。
farms: Dogger Bank wind farm · B, C
ports.coordNote: Port of Tyne south-bank (Tyne Dock) estate, South Shields; the exact O&M building/quay was not identified in OSM

ports.name: Teesworks – Steel River Quay (South Bank, River Tees)
ports.zh: Teesworks（蒂斯河 Steel River 碼頭）
ports.en: Steel River Quay marshals Hornsea 3 monopiles (first arrived Feb 2026). SeAH Wind's XXL monopile factory on site lost its Hornsea 3 order in Feb 2026 over factory readiness.
ports.zhNote: Steel River 碼頭為 Hornsea 3 單樁儲運組裝港（2026 年 2 月首批到港）；園區 SeAH 超大型單樁廠因產線未就緒，2026 年 2 月失去該訂單。
ports.coordNote: Midpoint of the new South Bank / Steel River Quay line on the Tees beside the SeAH monopile factory site (OSM)

ports.name: Port of Akita (Iijima)
ports.en: Base port (designated Sep 2020) leased to Akita Offshore Wind from Apr 2021; towers were pre-assembled here in 2022 for its 33 turbines in Akita and Noshiro ports.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，2021 年 4 月起租給秋田洋上風力發電，2022 年在此預組裝塔架，完成秋田港與能代港共 33 部風機。
ports.coordNote: Iijima-district base-port wharf and yard (OSM: 秋田港洋上風力発電施設建設工事拠点).

ports.name: Port of Aomori (Aburakawa)
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2024 for the Aomori Sea of Japan (South) promotion area; an Aburakawa wharf (-12 m, 230 m) is under construction from FY2024.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，服務青森縣外海日本海（南側）促進區域；油川地區碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 230 公尺）自 2024 年度起興建。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Aburakawa district shore of Aomori Port where the base-port wharf is being built.

ports.name: Port of Kashima (outer port)
ports.en: Base port designated Sep 2020; a ground-strengthened outer-port wharf (-12 m, 200 m) was built in FY2020-2024 for offshore wind installation.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，外港地區強化地耐力碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 200 公尺）於 2020 至 2024 年度興建，供離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Kashima Port harbour point near the outer-port (外港) district where the base-port wharf is.

ports.name: Port of Kitakyushu (Hibikinada)
ports.en: Base port (2020) leased to Hibiki Wind Energy, with exclusive use Oct 2024-Mar 2026 to build the 220 MW Kitakyushu Hibikinada farm; Ishikari Bay New Port's jackets were made in the port.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年指定為基地港灣，響灘東地區碼頭租給響灘風能，2024 年 10 月至 2026 年 3 月專供北九州響灘風場施工；石狩灣新港風場的套管式基礎也在北九州港製造。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Hibikinada East district base-port wharf (-10 m, 180 m), Wakamatsu ward. The Ishikari jackets were built elsewhere in Kitakyushu Port.

ports.name: Port of Niigata
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2023; a ground-strengthened -12 m wharf and berth have been under construction since FY2023 for offshore wind installation.
ports.zhNote: 2023 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，強化地耐力碼頭（水深 12 公尺）自 2023 年度起興建中，供離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Niigata East Port area (container terminal); MLIT's map places the base-port wharf in the South Wharf (南ふ頭) district, not mapped exactly.

ports.name: Port of Noshiro (Omori)
ports.en: Base port designated Sep 2020; a ground-strengthened Omori-district wharf (-10 m, 180 m) was built in FY2019-2024 for future offshore wind construction off Akita.
ports.zhNote: 2020 年 9 月指定為基地港灣，大森地區強化地耐力碼頭（水深 10 公尺、長 180 公尺）於 2019 至 2024 年度興建，供秋田外海離岸風場施工使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Omori-district base-port wharf near the Hamanasu observation deck, south side of the Noshiro Port basin.

ports.name: Port of Sakata (outer port)
ports.en: Designated a base port in Apr 2024 for the Yuza (Yamagata) promotion area; an outer-port wharf (-12 m, 230 m) and wave barrier are under construction from FY2024.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 4 月指定為基地港灣，服務山形縣遊佐町外海促進區域；外港地區碼頭（水深 12 公尺、長 230 公尺）及消波堤自 2024 年度起興建。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: outer-port (外港) district at Sakata North Port where the base-port wharf is being built.

ports.name: SK oceanplant yard, Goseong
ports.en: Korean jacket maker: jackets and piles for Taiwan's Taipower 1, Greater Changhua, Changfang-Xidao, Zhong Neng, Hai Long and Fengmiao 1, plus parts for Japan's Hibikinada and Ishikari.
ports.zhNote: 韓國主要水下基礎製造商，為台電一期、大彰化、彰芳暨西島、中能、海龍、渢妙一期製造套管式基礎與基樁，也供應日本響灘與石狩的基礎構件。
farmsOther: Jeju Kimnyoung test jackets (2010-2011, KHNP/Doosan)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: SK oceanplant's coastal yard in the Goseong shipbuilding special zone (Naesan-ri, Donghae-myeon, Gyeongsangnam-do).

ports.name: Eemshaven
ports.en: Gemini's monopiles and transition pieces sailed out from Eemshaven, and the port remains a maintenance base for North Sea wind farms including Gemini.
ports.zhNote: Gemini 風場的單樁與轉接段自 Eemshaven 出港安裝，該港也持續作為 Gemini 等北海風場的運維基地。
ports.coordNote: Beatrixhaven, Eemshaven's main harbour basin (OSM); the specific offshore wind quay was not identified

ports.name: Port of Rotterdam – Sif Maasvlakte 2
ports.en: Sif makes monopiles at Maasvlakte 2 (and Roermond) and runs a 628 m deep-sea marshalling quay; OranjeWind's first TP-less monopile was loaded out here in Sept 2026.
ports.zhNote: Sif 在 Maasvlakte 2（及 Roermond）製造單樁，並經營 628 公尺深水組裝儲運碼頭；OranjeWind 首支免轉接段單樁於 2026 年 9 月由此出港。
ports.coordNote: Midpoint of Sif's 628 m deep-sea quay on the west side of its Maasvlakte 2 site (OSM site polygon)

ports.name: Wergeland Base (Gulen)
ports.en: Hywind Tampen's turbines were mated to their floating concrete spar foundations at Wergeland Base in Gulen before tow-out (2022–23).
ports.zhNote: Hywind Tampen 的風機在 Gulen 的 Wergeland 基地與混凝土浮動式 spar 基礎組合後拖航出海（2022–23）。
ports.coordNote: Wergeland Base site on Sløvågen, Gulen (OSM node on the base); quay not mapped separately

ports.name: Port of Łeba (Baltic Power O&M base)
ports.en: Operations and maintenance base of Baltic Power, Poland's first offshore wind farm, launched in April 2025.
ports.zhNote: 波蘭首座離岸風場 Baltic Power 的運維基地，2025 年 4 月啟用。
ports.coordNote: Baltic Power site in the port of Łeba (OSM landuse polygon)

ports.name: Anping Port
ports.en: Backup offshore wind base: wharves 10, 11, 17 and 18 leased to developers since Dec 2023 to store and load out foundations; main working port of CDWE's installation vessel Green Jade.
ports.zhNote: 離岸風電備援基地：10、11、17、18 號碼頭自 2023 年 12 月起租給開發商儲放及裝運水下基礎，也是「環海翡翠輪」的主要作業港。
ports.coordNote: North quay of the Anping commercial harbour basin, Tainan (approximate position of wharves 10-11; wharves 17-18 are also leased).

ports.name: Mailiao Port
ports.en: Formosa Heavy Industries made pin piles for Greater Changhua 1&2a at its Mailiao plant, using Mailiao Harbour for laydown and shipping to the wind farm.
ports.zhNote: 台朔重工在麥寮廠製造大彰化東南及西南第一階段的水下基樁，並以麥寮港堆置及裝船運往風場。
ports.coordNote: Mailiao Port harbour basin (Formosa Plastics' industrial port, Yunlin); Formosa Heavy Industries' pin-pile yard inside the Mailiao complex is not mapped separately.

ports.name: Port of Kaohsiung
ports.en: CSBC used Kaohsiung Harbour to assemble and store pin piles for Greater Changhua 1&2a; A6-B jacket assembly yard (wharf done 2024) and Walsin-NKT cable plant with own wharf (opened 2025).
ports.zhNote: 台船以高雄港組裝儲放大彰化第一階段基樁；洲際一期 A6-B 有洲鉅風電水下基礎組裝廠（碼頭 2024 年完工），A6-A 有華新海纜廠及專用碼頭（2025 年 12 月啟用）。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: A6 plots of the Intercontinental Container Center Phase 1 (Xiaogang) - Walsin/NKT cable plant with the A6-A cable wharf and the A6-B jacket assembly yard; exact quays not mapped.

ports.name: Port of Taichung
ports.en: Taiwan's main offshore wind hub: pre-assembly for Formosa 1-2, Taipower 1, Greater Changhua, Changfang-Xidao, Zhong Neng, Yunlin; SGRE nacelles, CS Wind towers, Tien Li blades (to 2025); Ørsted O&M.
ports.zhNote: 台灣最主要的離岸風電組裝港：海洋、海能、台電一期、大彰化、彰芳暨西島、中能、允能在此預組裝；港內有西門子歌美颯機艙廠、塔架廠、沃旭運維中心；天力葉片廠 2025 年停產。
ports.coordNote: West quay of the south basin beside Industrial Zone II (wharf #106 area; Siemens Gamesa nacelle and Tien Li blade plants behind it) - approximate. Pre-assembly also uses wharves #2, #5A/5B and #35-38.

ports.name: Port of Taipei
ports.en: Taiwan's jacket-making base: Century Wind Power's South Wharf yard built the jackets for Taipower Phase 2 (stored at Wharf S9) and 21 jackets for Hai Long 2A.
ports.zhNote: 水下基礎製造基地：世紀風電台北港南碼頭廠製造台電離岸二期的套管式基礎（存放於南 9 碼頭）及海龍 2A 的 21 座套管式基礎。
ports.coordNote: Quay of Century Wind Power's jacket yard in the South Wharf area of Taipei Port (Bali, New Taipei).

ports.name: Xingda Port
ports.en: SDMS's 27 ha jacket yard here delivered 6 jackets to Greater Changhua 1&2a and 31 to Zhong Neng (part subcontracted to SK oceanplant); SDMS quit foundation work at end-2024.
ports.zhNote: 興達海基在興達港設 27 公頃管架式水下基礎廠，交付大彰化第一階段 6 座、中能 31 座（部分委由韓國 SK oceanplant 製造）；2024 年底退出水下基礎製造。
ports.coordNote: Sing Da Marine Structure (SDMS) yard on the east side of Xingda Harbour, Qieding, Kaohsiung (approximate quay position).

ports.name: Humboldt Bay Offshore Wind Heavy Lift Marine Terminal
ports.en: Planned heavy-lift terminal at Redwood Marine Terminal I on the Samoa Peninsula to assemble and stage floating wind turbines; lost a $426.7M federal grant in 2025, draft EIR due spring 2027.
ports.zhNote: 規劃於 Samoa 半島 Redwood Marine Terminal I 建重件碼頭，組裝暫存浮動式風機；2025 年 4.267 億美元聯邦補助遭取消，環評草案預計 2027 年春公布。
ports.coordNote: Project site at Redwood Marine Terminal I on the Samoa Peninsula, from the Harbor District's 2023 CEQA notice of preparation (40°49'0.4"N, 124°10'58.7"W).

ports.name: New Bedford Marine Commerce Terminal
ports.en: Completed in 2015 as the first US port purpose-built for offshore wind; staged and pre-assembled all 62 Vineyard Wind 1 turbines (2023–2026); no new tenant as of 2026.
ports.zhNote: 2015 年完工，是美國第一座專為離岸風電興建的港口；2023–2026 年為 Vineyard Wind 1 全部 62 部風機的預組裝與出港基地，2026 年尚無新租戶。
ports.coordNote: Terminal position published by MassCEC (41°37'23"N, 70°54'50"W) for the New Bedford Marine Commerce Terminal.

ports.name: Port of Coeymans
ports.en: Hudson River port where Riggs Distler assembled 84 sets of advanced foundation components (platforms, anode cages, monopile doors) for Sunrise Wind in 2023–2026, shipped down the river.
ports.zhNote: 哈德遜河畔港口；2023–2026 年 Riggs Distler 在此組裝 Sunrise Wind 的 84 套水下基礎組件（平台、陽極籠、單樁門），經河道運出。
ports.coordNote: Port of Coeymans Hudson River frontage: project location in Carver's 2020 joint permit application (42°29'10"N, 73°47'17"W).

ports.name: Portsmouth Marine Terminal
ports.zh: 樸次茅斯港（維吉尼亞州）
ports.en: Port of Virginia terminal with a $223M, 72-acre offshore wind staging area and three heavy-lift berths; marshalling port for Dominion's 176-turbine CVOW since 2023, first power March 2026.
ports.zhNote: 維吉尼亞港務局碼頭，設 72 英畝、2.23 億美元離岸風電組裝區與 3 座重件碼頭；2023 年起為 176 部風機的 CVOW 組裝港，2026 年 3 月首度供電。
farms: Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Commercial Project
ports.coordNote: Portsmouth Marine Terminal wharf, position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 3, ch. 9 (36°51'26"N, 76°19'33"W).

ports.name: ProvPort (Port of Providence)
ports.en: GE pre-assembled Block Island Wind Farm turbine components here in 2016; Ørsted/Eversource's foundation-component hub made platforms, anode cages and doors for South Fork Wind and Revolution Wind.
ports.zhNote: 2016 年 GE 在此預組裝 Block Island 風場風機；Ørsted/Eversource 的水下基礎組件廠為 South Fork 與 Revolution 風場製作平台等組件。
ports.coordNote: ProvPort Municipal Wharf, Berths 5 and 6, position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 2, ch. 6 (41°47'25"N, 71°22'54"W).

ports.name: Salem Offshore Wind Terminal
ports.en: Planned 42-acre Crowley/MassCEC terminal on the former Salem Harbor power-plant site, designed to stage floating-wind parts; on hold after a $34M federal grant was cancelled in 2025.
ports.zhNote: Crowley 與麻州清潔能源中心規劃在 Salem Harbor 舊電廠址建 42 英畝碼頭，可暫存浮動式風機組件；2025 年 3,400 萬美元聯邦補助遭取消，計畫停滯。
ports.coordNote: Former Salem Harbor power-plant wharf, the berth of the planned terminal; position from NOAA U.S. Coast Pilot 1, ch. 10 (42°31'27"N, 70°52'40"W).

ports.name: South Brooklyn Marine Terminal
ports.en: 73-acre Brooklyn terminal under reconstruction since 2024 as the turbine staging port and long-term O&M base of Equinor's 810 MW Empire Wind 1; turbine feeder runs planned from 2026.
ports.zhNote: 73 英畝的布魯克林碼頭，2024 年起改建為 Equinor 810 MW Empire Wind 1 的風機組裝港與長期運維基地，預計 2026 年起以駁船送出風機。
ports.coordNote: South Brooklyn Marine Terminal site (Wikipedia coordinates); marks the terminal, not a specific berth.

ports.name: State Pier, New London
ports.en: Connecticut Port Authority terminal rebuilt in 2021–23 with Ørsted and Eversource; since 2023 the turbine pre-assembly and load-out base for South Fork Wind, Revolution Wind and Sunrise Wind.
ports.zhNote: 康州港務局與Ørsted、Eversource 於 2021–23 年改建；2023 年起為 South Fork、Revolution、Sunrise 三座風場的風機預組裝與出港基地。
ports.coordNote: Central Vermont Railroad Pier (Wikipedia coordinates), which was merged with the adjacent State Pier into one heavy-lift platform in 2021–23.

ports.name: PTSC M&C fabrication yard, Vung Tau
ports.en: PTSC M&C's Vung Tau yard built the offshore substations (topsides, jackets, piles) for Hai Long 2 & 3 and four for Poland's Baltica 2, and is building one for Fengmiao.
ports.zhNote: PTSC M&C 頭頓廠製造海龍二、三號的海上變電站（上部結構、套管式基礎及基樁）與波蘭 Baltica 2 的 4 座變電站，並承建渢妙的變電站。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: PTSC petroleum service port and M&C fabrication yard on the Dinh River, Vung Tau (65A 30/4 Street, now part of Ho Chi Minh City).

ports.name: Rudong Xiaoyangkou wind-power port
ports.en: Rudong's Xiaoyangkou wind-power port, described as China's first offshore wind 'mother port', can ship out large offshore wind equipment on 5,000-tonne vessels around the clock for the Rudong offshore cluster.
ports.zhNote: 如東小洋口風電母港號稱國內首個海上風電母港，可供 5,000 噸級船舶全天候出運各類大型海上風電裝備，服務如東海域風場。
farmsOther: Rudong offshore farms (SPIC / CGN / CTG / Huaneng H-sites) — no source names a specific farm shipped from this quay; CGN Rudong Demonstration (38 x 4 MW) was reached by crew boat from Yangkou Port's Yangguang Island quay in 2016
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Xiaoyangkou harbour at the sea lock of Yangkou town, Rudong (OSM locality 小洋口 32.564,121.040; the wind-power quay itself is not tagged). Note: the 2016 crew-boat departure for the CGN demo farm was at Yangkou Port's Yangguang Island (32.527,121.42), 40 km east.

ports.name: Yangjiang Port (Jishu area)
ports.en: Port beside the 7.4 km2 Guangdong (Yangjiang) wind-power equipment base (Mingyang, Goldwind and 30+ suppliers; 31 manufacturing projects in operation); the Jishu area's J8 berth, accepted in 2026, is built for wind-equipment transport ships and turbines are exported from here.
ports.zhNote: 緊鄰 7.4 平方公里的廣東（陽江）風電裝備製造基地（明陽、金風等 30 餘家，31 個製造項目投產）；吉樹作業區 J8 泊位 2026 年交工，專供風電設備特種運輸船停靠，整機亦由此出口。
farmsOther: Yangjiang offshore farms (Shapa, Qingzhou, Nanpeng Island) — turbines made at the Yangjiang base, but no fetched source names which quay served which farm
China–Serbia wind project (6 turbine sets exported on the 'Sailun', 2025)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Jishu operating area on the east shore of Hailing Bay (OSM hamlet 吉树 21.715,111.816 and 阳江港 station 21.719,111.830); the J8 wind-equipment berth is not tagged.

ports.name: Jieyang Port (Qianzhan terminal)
ports.en: SPIC-built 70,000 t general terminal with a recessed basin designed from the outset for large wind components; called eastern Guangdong's first offshore wind 'mother port', it handles 2,000 t jackets from the neighbouring Huilai turbine-equipment base (operating since 2025).
ports.zhNote: 國家電投興建的 7 萬噸級通用碼頭，規劃階段即納入風電大部件運輸要素並採嵌入式港池，被稱為粵東首個海上風電母港；龍門吊吊運鄰近惠來臨港產業園製造的 2,000 噸導管架（2025 年投運）。
farmsOther: SPIC Jieyang Shenquan I / Shenquan I phase 2 / Shenquan II — SPIC's own terminal and jackets are shown being handled, but no source explicitly names the farm the jackets were for
ports.coordNote: Approximate: coast between Goushu and Chiwo villages east of Shenquan Bay, Qianzhan town, Huilai (location per the 2020 EIA approval; OSM shows the adjacent 惠来宁水海洋工程装备基地 at 22.939,116.388); the 70,000 t berth itself is not tagged.

ports.name: Shantou (Haojiang wind base / Guang'ao port)
ports.zh: 汕頭（濠江風電基地／廣澳港）
ports.en: Shanghai Electric's Shantou nacelle plant in Haojiang (settled 2017, 300 sets a year; Asia's first 11 MW machine assembled here in 2022) sits beside the 100,000 t Guang'ao deep-water port; a wind 'mother port' for construction, O&M and export is planned.
ports.zhNote: 上海電氣汕頭主機基地位於濠江（2017 年落戶，年產 300 套；2022 年組裝亞洲首台 11 MW 機組），緊鄰 10 萬噸級廣澳深水港；集施工、運維、出口於一體的海上風電母港仍在規劃。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Guang'ao port area and the Haojiang offshore wind industrial park (OSM 广澳街道 23.272,116.756); the Shanghai Electric plant and the planned wind quay are not tagged.

ports.name: Fuqing Jiangyin (CTG offshore wind industrial park)
ports.zh: 福清江陰（三峽海上風電國際產業園）
ports.en: China's first full-chain offshore wind park (Dongfang, Goldwind, CRRC, Sinohydro 4, LM): first turbine off the line Jan 2019, 16 MW (2022) and 18 MW (2023) prototypes; its products were used on all CTG Fujian farms, and 100 m+ blades have been exported to Europe from Jiangyin port since 2022.
ports.zhNote: 我國首個全產業鏈海上風電產業園（東方風電、金風、中車、水電四局、LM 葉片）：2019 年 1 月首台風機下線，2022／2023 年 16、18 MW 機組下線；產品用於三峽福建所有海上風場，百米級葉片自 2022 年起經江陰港區出口歐洲。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Jiangyin port area at the south end of the Jiangyin peninsula, Fuqing (OSM 江阴镇 25.459,119.316); the park's own heavy-cargo quay is not tagged.

ports.name: Penglai (Dajin Heavy Industry base)
ports.zh: 蓬萊（大金重工海工基地）
ports.en: Dajin's Penglai offshore base (in production since 2012) makes monopiles, towers, jackets and floating foundations on its own wind-equipment quay in the port hinterland, marketed as a 'Chinese Esbjerg'; it supplies XXL monopiles to European farms on a delivered (DAP) basis.
ports.zhNote: 大金重工蓬萊海工基地（2012 年投產）在港口腹地自有風電專用碼頭製造單樁、塔筒、導管架與浮式基礎，自稱打造中國的「埃斯比約風電母港」，以 DAP 方式向歐洲風場供應超大單樁。
farmsOther: Baltic Sea offshore wind project (10 XXL monopiles delivered 2025; owner not named)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Dajin's Penglai base on Zhenxing Road in the Penglai new-port district east of Penglai (OSM 振兴路 37.800–37.815, 120.89); the company's own wind-equipment quay is not tagged.

ports.name: Caofeidian (Dajin Heavy Industry base)
ports.zh: 曹妃甸（大金重工海工基地）
ports.en: Dajin's second offshore base, in production from the first half of 2026 with about 400,000 t/yr of XXL monopiles, floating foundations and jackets for 15–25 MW turbines, with its own 100,000 t deep-water quay linking fabrication, coating and load-out; first export monopiles completed.
ports.zhNote: 大金重工第二座海工基地，2026 年上半年投產，年產約 40 萬噸 15–25 MW 級超大單樁、浮式基礎與導管架，配套 10 萬噸級專用深水碼頭銜接生產、塗裝與裝船；已完成首批出口單樁。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Caofeidian industrial zone, Tangshan (OSM 曹妃甸港 railway station node 39.073,118.461, the nearest tagged feature of the port zone); the Dajin base and its 100,000 t deep-water quay are not tagged — low confidence.

ports.name: Dongying Port (Guangli area)
ports.en: Guangli's dedicated wind-power berth serves the 22.4 km2 Dongying offshore wind equipment park (CSSC Haizhuang, Shanghai Electric, Jinlei, Shuangrui blades; about 300 10 MW-class turbines a year, 15 minutes from factory to quay); first 107 m blades shipped to Shandong Energy's Bozhong farm in Sept 2022.
ports.zhNote: 廣利港區風電專用碼頭服務 22.4 平方公里的東營海上風電裝備產業園（中船海裝、上海電氣、金雷、雙瑞葉片；年產約 300 台 10 MW 級機組，廠區到碼頭 15 分鐘）；2022 年 9 月首船 107 米葉片運往山東能源渤中風場。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Guangli port area at the mouth of the Guangli River on the Bohai coast east of Dongying; the wind-power berth (general wharf phase II) is not tagged on OSM.

ports.name: Liuheng Island, Xiaoguoju wind quay (Zhoushan)
ports.zh: 舟山六橫小郭巨風機專用碼頭
ports.en: 2,000 t dedicated quay built for Guodian's Zhoushan Putuo 6#2 farm (accepted July 2017): one turbine pre-assembly/load-out berth, one auxiliary berth and a 53,000 m2 yard, China's first wind quay usable by both fixed and crawler cranes. Use after the 2017–2019 construction is not verified.
ports.zhNote: 為國電舟山普陀 6 號 2 區風場興建的 2,000 噸級專用碼頭（2017 年 7 月交工）：風機拼裝出運泊位與輔助泊位各一、5.3 萬平方米後方堆場，全國首座兼顧固定吊與履帶吊的碼頭；2017–2019 年施工期之後的用途未查證。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Xiaoguoju phase-1 reclamation area on the south side of Liuheng Island, Putuo, Zhoushan; the 2,000 t quay is not tagged on OSM (Liuheng island features at 29.73–29.77, 122.03–122.12).

ports.name: Shanwei (Lufeng) marine engineering base
ports.zh: 汕尾（陸豐）海洋工程基地
ports.en: CGN-anchored base where Mingyang (nacelles and blades, from May 2020), Zhongtian's Nanhai submarine-cable plant, Tianneng and others produce the main equipment for CGN's Shanwei farms and ship it from the base's two quays (3 berths, 1.455 Mt/yr) — called China's largest offshore wind mother port, also used for O&M.
ports.zhNote: 以中廣核為鏈主的基地：明陽（整機、葉片，2020 年 5 月投產）、中天南海海纜、天能重工等在此生產中廣核汕尾風場主設備，經基地 2 座碼頭（3 泊位，年通過能力 145.5 萬噸）運往風場，號稱國內最大海上風電母港，兼運維。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Lufeng marine engineering base on Jieshi Bay west of Jieshi town (OSM 碣石镇 22.820,115.826); the base's two quays are not tagged.

ports.name: Yancheng Port (Sheyang area)
ports.en: Yancheng Port, described as east China's main export port for large domestic wind blades; in June 2026 Sheyang shipped Envision EN-226/8.X MW offshore turbine components (blades, generators, towers) for Vietnam's Vinh Long nearshore farm.
ports.zhNote: 鹽城港為華東大型國產風電葉片核心出口港；2026 年 6 月射陽港出口遠景 EN-226/8.X MW 海上風機部件（葉片、發電機、塔筒）至越南永隆近海風場。
farmsOther: Vinh Long 128 MW nearshore wind project, Vietnam (Envision turbine components exported June 2026)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Sheyang port area at the mouth of the Sheyang River; Nominatim returned nothing for 射阳港 and the wind-equipment berth is not tagged — low confidence.

ports.name: Pinghai fishing port, Putian
ports.en: Fishing harbour at Pinghai (Xiuyu, Putian) from which O&M crews board service boats to the Pinghai Bay offshore wind farm; documented by a Xinhua photographer's Jan 2025 trip to the farm's turbine 34.
ports.zhNote: 秀嶼區平海漁港碼頭是平海灣海上風電場運維人員搭運維船出海的基地（新華社記者 2025 年 1 月隨運維人員自此出發至 34 號風機）。
farmsOther: Putian Pinghai Bay offshore wind farm (phases 1–3; the source does not say which phase turbine 34 belongs to)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Pinghai fishing harbour, Pinghai town, Xiuyu district (OSM 平海镇 25.185,119.269); the O&M crew-boat berth is not tagged.

ports.name: Mokpo New Port
ports.en: Korea's offshore wind support port with two existing support berths: Jeonnam 1 used it as its back port and Nakwol's towers were stored here in 2025; two more 30,000 DWT berths are in the 4th port plan revision, and Vestas/Maersk plan a turbine factory in the port's hinterland.
ports.zhNote: 韓國現有兩個海上風電支援泊位的港口：全南 1 號以此為後勤港，落月風場塔架 2025 年在此堆放；第四次港灣基本計畫修正案新增兩個 3 萬 DWT 泊位，Vestas 與 Maersk 規劃在港後腹地設風機廠。
ports.coordNote: OSM industrial area 목포신항 (34.756,126.353), Yudal-dong, Mokpo; the two existing offshore-wind support berths are not tagged separately.

ports.name: Gunsan Port (pier 7)
ports.en: Chosen in 2012 as the support port for the Southwest offshore wind complex (unloading, storage, assembly and transport of turbines and substructures); in July 2026 berth 75 of pier 7 was designated an offshore wind support port in the 4th national port plan revision, with berths 76–77 proposed.
ports.zhNote: 2012 年獲選為西南海海上風電園區的支援港（風機與水下結構的卸載、堆放、組裝、運輸）；2026 年 7 月第 7 碼頭 75 號泊位納入第四次全國港灣基本計畫修正案列為海上風電支援港，並擬擴及 76、77 號泊位。
farmsOther: Southwest Offshore Demonstration (Seonam) — Gunsan was selected as its support port in 2012; actual use for the 60 MW demo not confirmed by a quotable source
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Gunsan (Gunjang) port yard, Osikdo-dong (OSM yard 군산항 35.972,126.560); berth 75 of pier 7 is not tagged.

ports.name: Ulsan New Port (south, floating-wind support quay)
ports.zh: 蔚山新港（南新港浮動式風電支援碼頭）
ports.en: Ulsan Port Authority is promoting a floating offshore wind support quay in the south new port for the 1.5 GW-class floating projects (Gray Whale and others) planned about 60 km off Ulsan; planning stage only.
ports.zhNote: 蔚山港灣公社在南新港推動浮動式海上風電支援碼頭，服務距蔚山約 60 公里、1.5 GW 級的浮動式風場（歸神鯨等）；目前僅在規劃階段。
farmsOther: Ulsan floating projects (Donghae Gray Whale 1–3, KF Wind, Firefly/Bandibuli, Haeuli) — planned; no quay use yet
ports.coordNote: Approximate: southern part of Ulsan New Port (OSM yard 울산신항 35.467,129.372); the planned floating-wind support quay has no tagged location.

ports.name: LS Cable Donghae plant (Donghae port)
ports.zh: 東海（LS 電纜海底電纜廠）
ports.en: Korea's only submarine power-cable plant: cables are fed by gangway straight from the factory onto lay vessels at Donghae port, including about 130 km for Taiwan's Miaoli (Formosa) offshore wind farms loaded in 2020; plant 2 (2020) raised capacity 250% and an HVDC hall followed.
ports.zhNote: 韓國唯一的海底電力電纜廠：電纜經棧橋直接自廠區送上東海港的鋪纜船，2020 年裝運約 130 公里供台灣苗栗（海洋／海能）離岸風場；第二廠 2020 年完工後產能增加 250%。
farmsOther: Taiwan Miaoli offshore wind farms (Formosa 1 / Formosa 2 area; about 130 km of cable loaded out 2020–21 — the source names only Miaoli county)
ports.coordNote: OSM works 'LS전선 동해공장' (37.490,129.118), Songjeong-dong, Donghae; cables are loaded onto lay vessels at the adjacent Donghae port about 300 m away via a gangway.

ports.name: Port of Currimao
ports.en: One of three ports DOE and the Philippine Ports Authority chose in Sept 2024 to repurpose for offshore wind (near 13 service contracts, 9,489 MW); expected to serve BuhaWind's 2,000 MW Northern Luzon project. Funding was still unresolved in 2026.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 9 月菲律賓能源部與港務局選定改造為離岸風電港的三港之一（鄰近 13 個服務契約、9,489 MW），預計服務 BuhaWind 2,000 MW 北呂宋計畫；2026 年經費仍未落實。
farms: Northern Luzon Offshore Wind Power Project
ports.coordNote: OSM industrial area 'Port of Currimao' (17.988,120.487), Maglaoi Norte, Currimao; no wind quay exists yet.

ports.name: Port of Batangas (Sta. Clara)
ports.en: Priority port chosen by DOE/PPA in Sept 2024 for offshore wind (close to 29 service contracts, 24,300 MW), expected to serve BuhaWind's 1,000 MW Northern Mindoro project; PNOC signed an MoU with Batangas province in March 2025 to study an offshore wind integration port.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 9 月能源部／港務局選定的離岸風電優先港（鄰近 29 個服務契約、24,300 MW），預計服務 BuhaWind 1,000 MW 北民都洛計畫；2025 年 3 月菲律賓國家石油公司與八打雁省簽署備忘錄研究離岸風電整合港。
ports.coordNote: OSM ferry terminal ramps of Batangas port, Santa Clara, Batangas City (13.754,121.041); no wind quay exists yet.

ports.name: Port of Jose Panganiban
ports.zh: 何塞潘加尼班港（北甘馬粦）
ports.en: Third of the DOE/PPA priority ports for offshore wind (Sept 2024), near 14 service contracts with 8,150 MW in the San Miguel Bay / Lamon Bay area; PPA to do the feasibility study and infrastructure works.
ports.zhNote: 能源部／港務局 2024 年 9 月的第三個離岸風電優先港，鄰近聖米格爾灣一帶 14 個服務契約、8,150 MW；由港務局負責可行性研究與基礎建設。
farmsOther: San Miguel Bay / Lamon Bay / Capalonga service contracts (14 OWESCs, 8,150 MW — not named individually in the source)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: end of the Jose Panganiban port road (OSM 14.293,122.690), North Poblacion; the port itself is not tagged.

ports.name: Agila Subic (former Hanjin shipyard)
ports.zh: 蘇比克灣 Agila Subic 船廠
ports.en: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries leased part of Cerberus's Agila Subic shipyard in May 2024 to manufacture offshore wind substructures (about USD 550 m over ten years); a 2026 GWEC study names Agila Subic the strongest candidate for the country's primary offshore wind hub.
ports.zhNote: HD 現代重工 2024 年 5 月租用 Cerberus 的 Agila Subic 船廠部分場地製造離岸風電水下結構（十年約 5.5 億美元）；GWEC 2026 年報告認為 Agila Subic 是菲律賓主要離岸風電樞紐港的最佳候選。
ports.coordNote: OSM industrial area 'Agila Subic' (14.816,120.203), Subic, Zambales — the former Hanjin shipyard at Redondo peninsula.

ports.name: Dafeng Port (Yancheng)
ports.en: One of China's three main wind-blade export ports (1,902 blades exported in 2018, first among Jiangsu ports; a record 156 blades loaded on one ship), with a dedicated blade yard for the TPI Dafeng plant; O&M crews for Guoxin's 850 MW Dafeng farm sail from here on crew boats.
ports.zhNote: 中國風電葉片出口三大基本港之一（2018 年出口 1,902 片、居江蘇口岸第一；單船 156 片創紀錄），海關為迪皮埃大豐廠設葉片專用集貨場；國信大豐 85 萬千瓦風場的運維人員自此搭交通船出海巡檢。
farmsOther: Blade exports to the US, Europe and Australia (farms not named)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: OSM node named 大丰港 (boatyard) in the Dafeng port area; the blade storage yard and the crew-boat berth are not tagged.

ports.name: Rushan Port (Shandong offshore wind equipment base)
ports.zh: 乳山港（山東海上風電裝備製造產業乳山基地）
ports.en: One of Shandong's three offshore wind equipment bases (designated June 2021): a 9,000 mu park around Rushan Port with Envision and Mingyang turbine plants, Haili monopiles, CRRC towers, Zhongtian cables and 100+ firms; ships loaded with turbines, blades, monopiles and towers leave from the base, and over half the main equipment of the farms off Rushan is made here.
ports.zhNote: 山東三大海上風電裝備製造基地之一（2021 年 6 月納入）：乳山港周邊 9,000 畝園區集聚遠景、明陽整機廠與海力單樁、中車塔架、中天海纜等百餘家企業，裝載風機、葉片、單樁、塔筒的貨輪自基地出海；乳山海域風場主設備「乳山造」配套率逾五成。
farms: Shandong Huaneng Offshore L Area wind farm
farmsOther: Shandong Peninsula South farms off Rushan (U site and others; sources say the main equipment comes from Rushan but name no shipment per farm)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: harbour at the Rushan river mouth (乳山口), Rushan, Weihai; the base's load-out quays are not tagged on OSM — low confidence.

ports.name: Wenzhou Zhuangyuan'ao (Zhejiang deep-sea wind mother port)
ports.zh: 溫州狀元岙（浙江深遠海風電母港）
ports.en: China's first mother port aimed at deep-sea wind, under construction on Zhuangyuan'ao island since 26 Dec 2024 (Zhejiang Offshore Wind Development Co.): phase 1 for turbine/foundation assembly and heavy marine equipment with a 3,800 t gantry crane (installed 2026) and jacket production due by end-2026; phase 2 to add floating foundations, O&M and certification; Ningbo Xiangshan is the extension area.
ports.zhNote: 全國首個面向深遠海的風電母港，2024 年 12 月 26 日在狀元岙開工（浙江省海洋風電發展公司）：一期為風機基礎總裝與重型海工裝備製造，3,800 噸龍門吊 2026 年就位、年內具備導管架生產能力；二期擴大漂浮式基礎、運維、認證；寧波象山為拓展區。
farmsOther: Zhejiang deep-sea (national waters) demonstration projects — planned
ports.coordNote: OSM island node 状元岙岛 (27.889,121.125), Dongtou district, Wenzhou; the mother-port quay under construction is not tagged. NOTE: the island lies about 19 km outside the Natural Earth 1:50m coastline, beyond qa_ports.py's 15 km limit.

ports.name: Xiangshan Hepu (CSSC Haizhuang wind park dock)
ports.zh: 寧波象山鶴浦（中船海裝風電產業園碼頭）
ports.en: A 5,000 t dock (130 m x 35 m, 7.5 m depth, 99,600 t/yr) began construction on 24 June 2024 at Hepu, Xiangshan, to store and ship nacelles, blades, hubs and gearboxes from CSSC's offshore wind industrial park, billed as East China's largest offshore turbine assembly base; Xiangshan is also the extension area of Zhejiang's deep-sea wind mother port.
ports.zhNote: 2024 年 6 月 24 日在象山鶴浦開工的 5,000 噸級碼頭（130×35 公尺、前沿水深 7.5 公尺、年通過能力 99,600 噸），供中船海裝海上風電產業園儲運主機、葉片、輪轂、齒輪箱，號稱華東最大海上風電整機總裝基地；象山亦為浙江深遠海風電母港拓展區。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Hepu town, Xiangshan county (OSM admin node 29.153,121.894, Nantian Island); the 5,000 t dock site is not tagged.

ports.name: Vlissingen Buitenhaven (North Sea Port)
ports.en: Ørsted's maintenance site for Borssele 1&2 (94 turbines, 752 MW) in the Buitenhaven next to Vlissingen station employs about 70 people; North Sea Port says over 80 offshore wind farms have been installed from its Vlissingen port area.
ports.zhNote: Ørsted 在弗利辛恩車站旁的外港設有 Borssele 1&2（94 部風機、752 MW）運維基地，約 70 人；North Sea Port 稱已有 80 多座離岸風場從弗利辛恩港區出港安裝。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Buitenhaven (outer harbour) next to Vlissingen railway station, where Ørsted's maintenance site stands; exact quay not identified on a map.

ports.name: Port of Den Helder (Blue Port Centre)
ports.en: RWE and TotalEnergies chose Den Helder's Blue Port Centre (former fish auction) as the base for the 795 MW OranjeWind farm 80 km offshore: construction support from 2026, SOV-based O&M from 2028.
ports.zhNote: RWE 與 TotalEnergies 選定登海爾德的 Blue Port Centre（舊魚市）作為 80 公里外 795 MW OranjeWind 風場基地：2026 年起支援施工，2028 年起以 SOV 運維。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Blue Port Centre, the former fish auction building on the quay of Den Helder harbour (Het Nieuwe Diep); position not verified on a map.

ports.name: Port of IJmuiden (O&M hub: Vattenfall, Eneco, Vestas)
ports.en: O&M hub for the Dutch coast: Vattenfall's base for Hollandse Kust Zuid (30 technicians), Eneco's maintenance base for Luchterduinen and Prinses Amalia (offices since 2015), Vestas' hub for Egmond aan Zee; the IJmondhaven was OWEZ's construction base in 2006.
ports.zhNote: 荷蘭海岸運維樞紐：Vattenfall 的 Hollandse Kust Zuid 基地（30 名技師）、Eneco 的 Luchterduinen 與 Prinses Amalia 維護基地（2015 年起）、Vestas 的 Egmond aan Zee 服務點；2006 年 IJmondhaven 是 OWEZ 的施工基地。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: IJmond harbour area (IJmuiden fishing and offshore harbour south of the North Sea Canal locks); Vattenfall's service hub quay not identified.

ports.name: Port of Emden (Ørsted SOV base)
ports.en: Home port of Ørsted's service operation vessel Wind of Change since 2019 for Borkum Riffgrund 1&2 and Gode Wind 1&2; Ørsted runs O&M for its German farms, Borkum Riffgrund 3 and Gode Wind 3 included, from Norddeich, Emden and Eemshaven.
ports.zhNote: 2019 年起為 Ørsted 運維船 Wind of Change 的母港，服務 Borkum Riffgrund 1&2 與 Gode Wind 1&2；Ørsted 德國風場（含 Borkum Riffgrund 3、Gode Wind 3）由 Norddeich、埃姆登與 Eemshaven 運維。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Emden outer harbour (Außenhafen); the berth of Ørsted's service operation vessel not identified.

ports.name: Nordenham (Steelwind monopile plant)
ports.en: Dillinger's Steelwind Nordenham plant, on the Weser with its own wharf, has made monopiles and transition pieces since 2014; it supplied the 64 monopiles for He Dreiht and will build about 200 monopiles for RWE from 2027 under a 2024 framework agreement.
ports.zhNote: Dillinger 集團的 Steelwind 諾登哈姆廠位於威悉河畔、自有碼頭，2014 年起生產單樁與過渡段；供應 He Dreiht 的 64 支單樁，並依 2024 年框架協議自 2027 年起為 RWE 生產約 200 支。
farmsOther: RWE offshore farms due to start operating from end-2029 (up to 300 monopiles under the 2024 framework agreement)
ports.coordNote: Steelwind Nordenham plant site on the Weser bank north of Nordenham (OSM landuse=industrial 'Steelwind', way 213115192, centre 53.524, 8.549); the load-out wharf itself is not tagged.

ports.name: Port of Aalborg (East Port, Siemens Gamesa blade factory)
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's offshore blade factory in Aalborg East Port employs about 1,500 people and ships blades through the port; Bladt Industries and Semco Maritime build five 880 MW offshore substations on a 110,000 m² East Port site.
ports.zhNote: Siemens Gamesa 奧爾堡東港離岸葉片廠約 1,500 人，葉片經港口出貨；Bladt Industries 與 Semco Maritime 在東港 11 萬平方公尺基地製造五座 880 MW 離岸變電站。
farmsOther: Five 880 MW offshore substations by Bladt/Semco for unnamed international projects
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Østhavnen (East Port) industrial quay area east of Aalborg on the Limfjord, where the Siemens Gamesa blade factory and the Bladt/Semco substation site are; exact quay not identified.

ports.name: Odense Port – Lindø (Vestas nacelles, CS Wind Offshore monopiles)
ports.en: Denmark's largest offshore wind production port on the former Lindø shipyard: Vestas assembles offshore nacelles (600+ built, V236-15.0 MW line), CS Wind Offshore (ex-Bladt) makes monopiles and substations; some Baltic Power nacelles came from Lindø.
ports.zhNote: 丹麥最大離岸風電生產港，建於舊 Lindø 造船廠：Vestas 組裝離岸機艙（已逾 600 部、V236-15.0 MW 產線），CS Wind Offshore（前 Bladt）製造單樁與變電站；Baltic Power 部分機艙出自林島廠。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: former Lindø shipyard quay at Munkebo (Odense Port's Lindø industrial park); exact load-out quay not identified.

ports.name: Port of Brest (polder: Navantia–Windar jacket yard, Haizea Breizh towers)
ports.en: Navantia–Windar assembled jacket components for the 62 Saint-Brieuc foundations on an 11 ha plot of the Brest polder (about 250 jobs); Haizea Breizh with SPIE, in the port since 2022, assembled the towers for Saint-Brieuc's 62 turbines and then for Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier.
ports.zhNote: Navantia–Windar 在布雷斯特填海區 11 公頃基地組裝 Saint-Brieuc 62 座套管式基礎的構件（約 250 人）；Haizea Breizh 與 SPIE 自 2022 年在港內組裝 Saint-Brieuc 62 部風機的塔架，接著組裝 Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier 的塔架。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: the 'polder' reclaimed industrial area at the east end of Brest's commercial port; the 11 ha Navantia–Windar yard was at its northern part. Not verified on a map.

ports.name: Port-la-Nouvelle (offshore wind terminal)
ports.en: The Occitanie Region's purpose-built offshore wind terminal where the three 10 MW EFGL floating turbines were assembled on their floaters in 2025 (Euroports/Mammoet) before being towed 16 km off Leucate and Barcarès.
ports.zhNote: 奧克西塔尼大區專建的離岸風電碼頭，2025 年 EFGL 三部 10 MW 浮動式風機在此與浮台組裝（Euroports／Mammoet），再拖至 Leucate 與 Barcarès 外海 16 公里處。
farms: Les Éoliennes Flottantes du Golfe du Lion (EFGL)
farmsOther: EolMed (Gruissan) – reported to be assembled here too, not verified (source unreachable)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: the new heavy-lift offshore wind terminal in the extended outer port built by the Occitanie Region (SEMOP Port-La Nouvelle); exact quay not identified.

ports.name: Fos-sur-Mer (Port of Marseille Fos – Eiffage Métal yard, Quai Gloria)
ports.en: Eiffage Métal and Smulders built the three Provence Grand Large tension-leg floats at their Fos-sur-Mer plant; the floats were launched by submersible barge and the 8.4 MW turbines fitted at the Graveleau and Gloria quays in 2023. Later floating projects here are unverified.
ports.zhNote: Eiffage Métal 與 Smulders 在福斯廠製造 Provence Grand Large 三座張力腳浮台，2023 年以半潛駁船下水、在 Graveleau 與 Gloria 碼頭裝上 8.4 MW 風機；之後是否續作浮動式風電未能查證。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Fos-sur-Mer port area (Quai Graveleau / Quai Gloria used for the Provence Grand Large float launch and turbine assembly); exact quay not verified on a map.

ports.name: Świnoujście Offshore Terminal (ORLEN Neptun)
ports.zh: 希維諾烏伊希切離岸風電安裝碼頭
ports.en: Poland's first offshore wind installation terminal, opened by ORLEN Neptun on 10 June 2025 for 15 MW-class turbines and jack-up vessels; leased almost entirely to Ocean Winds to prepare and load out foundations for BC-Wind, and the base for ORLEN's Baltic East.
ports.zhNote: 波蘭首座離岸風電安裝碼頭，ORLEN Neptun 2025 年 6 月 10 日啟用，可服務 15 MW 級風機與自升式船；幾乎全區租予 Ocean Winds 作 BC-Wind 基礎的整備與出港，亦為 ORLEN Baltic East 的基地。
farmsOther: ORLEN Baltic East and later ORLEN phase-two projects
ports.coordNote: ORLEN Neptun installation terminal site on the east bank of the Świna, Świnoujście (OSM way 202802684 landuse=industrial 'Orlen Neptun', centre 53.895, 14.269; not the Orlen fuel depot 1.3 km north); the quay line itself is not tagged.

ports.name: Port of Gdańsk – T5 installation terminal
ports.zh: 格但斯克港 T5 安裝碼頭
ports.en: A 21.3 ha installation terminal built by Istrana (Polish Development Fund / Baltic Hub) and leased by PGE and Ørsted for storage, pre-assembly and load-out of the 107 Baltica 2 turbines from 2027; Ocean Winds has reserved it for BC-Wind in 2028.
ports.zhNote: Istrana（波蘭發展基金／Baltic Hub）興建的 21.3 公頃安裝碼頭，PGE 與 Ørsted 承租，2027 年起作 Baltica 2 共 107 部風機的儲放、預組裝與出港；Ocean Winds 已預約 2028 年供 BC-Wind 使用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: T5 site being built on water-covered port land next to Baltic Hub (DCT) in Gdańsk's outer port (Port Północny); berths not yet built.

ports.name: Szczecin (Vestas offshore nacelle factory, Ostrów Brdowski)
ports.zh: 什切青（Vestas 離岸機艙廠）
ports.en: Vestas' first offshore factory in Poland assembles V236-15.0 MW nacelles and hubs on Ostrów Brdowski (600+ staff); its first nacelles were installed at Baltic Power in November 2025. A V236 blade factory on a nearby site was announced for 2026.
ports.zhNote: Vestas 在波蘭的首座離岸工廠，於 Ostrów Brdowski 島組裝 V236-15.0 MW 機艙與輪轂（逾 600 人），2025 年 11 月首批機艙裝於 Baltic Power；鄰近基地的 V236 葉片廠原訂 2026 年投產。
farmsOther: Blade factory for the V236-15.0 MW announced for 2026 – opening not verified
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Ostrów Brdowski island on the Oder in northern Szczecin, site of the Vestas nacelle assembly factory; the planned blade factory is on a nearby site. Not verified on a map.

ports.name: Port of Viana do Castelo (WindFloat Atlantic O&M base)
ports.en: WindFloat Atlantic (3 × 8.4 MW, 18 km off Viana do Castelo, in operation since 2020) is operated and maintained from an O&M base in the commercial port of Viana do Castelo, which also served as the commissioning base.
ports.zhNote: WindFloat Atlantic（3 × 8.4 MW，距維亞納堡 18 公里，2020 年運轉）由維亞納堡商港內的運維基地營運維護，該港亦為試運轉基地。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: commercial port of Viana do Castelo on the north bank of the Lima estuary; the O&M base's quay not identified.

ports.name: Port of Taranto (Beleolico)
ports.en: The port received the monopiles for Beleolico (10 turbines, 30 MW), the Mediterranean's first offshore wind farm built in Taranto's outer roadstead and inaugurated on 21 April 2022; the port authority also offers its spaces for wind farm maintenance and manufacturing.
ports.zhNote: 2021 年接收 Beleolico（10 部風機、30 MW）的單樁，該風場建於塔蘭托港外錨地，2022 年 4 月 21 日啟用，是地中海第一座離岸風場；港務局另表示港區空間可供風電維護與製造。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: harbour – Taranto's Mar Grande port; the Haizea monopiles were landed on the port's quays and the farm stands in the port's outer roadstead. Exact quay not identified.

ports.name: Rosslare Europort (ORE Hub)
ports.en: Iarnród Éireann's planned €220 million Offshore Renewable Energy hub: about 80 ha with two heavy-lift berths for turbine components, dredging, land reclamation and O&M facilities; planning application under review in 2026.
ports.zhNote: 愛爾蘭鐵路公司規劃的 2.2 億歐元離岸再生能源樞紐：約 80 公頃，含兩座重件碼頭、疏浚、填海與運維設施；2026 年規劃申請審查中。
farmsOther: Irish Sea and Celtic Sea projects within 50–100 nautical miles (unnamed)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: harbour – the planned ORE hub on reclaimed land beside the existing Rosslare Europort; berths not yet built.

ports.name: Port of Cork – Ringaskiddy (CORE-1 quay)
ports.en: Port of Cork is extending its Ringaskiddy West deepwater berth by 182 m and completing a 200 m multi-purpose berth (CORE-1) designed for offshore renewable energy components under a 10-year permission renewed in 2025; phase one of the berth has operated since 2022.
ports.zhNote: 科克港依 2025 年更新的 10 年許可，將 Ringaskiddy West 深水碼頭延長 182 公尺並完成 200 公尺多用途碼頭（CORE-1），專為離岸再生能源組件設計；碼頭第一期自 2022 年啟用。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Ringaskiddy deepwater berth in Cork's lower harbour; the CORE-1 offshore renewable energy quay is the multi-purpose berth under construction beside it. Not verified on a map.

ports.name: Shannon Foynes Port (Foynes Island deepwater port)
ports.en: Vision 2041 masterplan (reviewed by Bechtel, 2022) and a 2023 MoU with ESB plan a floating wind hub on the Shannon Estuary: turbine integration and pre-commissioning plus an O&M base at a new Foynes Island deepwater port, substructure assembly at Moneypoint and wet storage in the estuary.
ports.zhNote: Vision 2041 總體規劃（Bechtel 2022 年審視）與 2023 年和 ESB 的備忘錄規劃香農河口浮動式風電樞紐：新建 Foynes 島深水港作風機整合、試運轉與運維基地，Moneypoint 組裝浮台，河口濕存放。
farmsOther: ESB Green Atlantic @ Moneypoint (floating platform fabrication and assembly hub)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Foynes Island / Port of Foynes on the south shore of the Shannon Estuary; the deepwater terminal is only planned.

ports.name: Port of Dundee (DunEco Quay renewables hub)
ports.en: Forth Ports' £40 million purpose-built renewables hub (operational 2022, 485 m heavy-lift quay): marshalling and tower assembly for Neart na Gaoithe until April 2025, next the marine hub for the 72-turbine Inch Cape wind farm.
ports.zhNote: Forth Ports 投資 4,000 萬英鎊的專用再生能源樞紐（2022 年啟用、485 公尺重件碼頭）：2025 年 4 月前為 Neart na Gaoithe 的組裝出港與塔架組立基地，接著將服務 72 部風機的 Inch Cape 風場。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Forth Ports' renewables hub (DunEco Quay, 485 m heavy-lift quay) on the north bank of the Tay east of Dundee's docks; exact quay position not verified on a map.

ports.name: New Jersey Wind Port (Artificial Island, Lower Alloways Creek)
ports.en: State-built marshalling port on Artificial Island (PSEG land, 78-year lease): the 30-acre Parcel A was completed in May 2024, but Ørsted's Ocean Wind 1 was cancelled and in February 2025 NJEDA accelerated a strategic review of alternative uses for the site.
ports.zhNote: 州政府在 Artificial Island（向 PSEG 租地 78 年）興建的組裝出港港：30 英畝的 Parcel A 於 2024 年 5 月完工，但 Ørsted 的 Ocean Wind 1 已取消，NJEDA 2025 年 2 月加速檢討此地的替代用途。
farmsOther: Ocean Wind 1 (Ørsted sublease 2023; project later cancelled)
Atlantic Shores Project 1 (LOI 2023, 35 acres from mid-2026)
ports.coordNote: Artificial Island on the Delaware River (Wikipedia: 39.4757, -75.5360); the marshalling terminal is on the island's north-western shore next to PSEG's nuclear site – position approximate.

ports.name: Pier Wind (Port of Long Beach)
ports.zh: 長灘港 Pier Wind 碼頭
ports.en: Proposed $4.7 billion, 400-acre built-land terminal for assembling the largest floating offshore wind turbines, in environmental review; the California Energy Commission awarded $20 million for design in October 2025, construction could start in 2027 and the first acres open by 2031.
ports.zhNote: 規劃中的 47 億美元、400 英畝填築碼頭，用於組裝最大型浮動式離岸風機，環評審查中；加州能源委員會 2025 年 10 月撥 2,000 萬美元設計經費，最快 2027 年動工、2031 年啟用首期。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: proposed 400-acre terminal to be built on new land in the Port of Long Beach's outer harbour south-west of Pier J; not yet built.

ports.name: Vineyard Haven – Tisbury Marine Terminal (Vineyard Wind O&M)
ports.zh: 葡萄園港（蒂斯伯里海運碼頭）
ports.en: Vineyard Wind 1's O&M base on Martha's Vineyard: the Tisbury Marine Terminal (site works from late 2022, newly built by June 2024) berths up to three crew transfer vessels, with the O&M service building on Beach Road nearby.
ports.zhNote: Vineyard Wind 1 在瑪莎葡萄園島的運維基地：蒂斯伯里海運碼頭（2022 年底動工，2024 年 6 月已建成）可停靠三艘人員運輸船，運維大樓在附近的 Beach Road。
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Tisbury Marine Terminal on Packer family land beside the Packer barge yard on Beach Road, Vineyard Haven harbour; the O&M building is on the former Hinckley hardware site nearby. Not verified on a map.

ports.name: Port of Davisville, Quonset Point (South Fork Wind crew base)
ports.zh: 昆塞特角戴維斯維爾港
ports.en: South Fork Wind's crew transfer vessels and crew-change helicopter are based at Quonset Point, where Ørsted has its Operations Hub (CTV Gripper berthed there from 2024); service vessels call at the state-owned Port of Davisville and Revolution Wind's export cable lands at Quonset Point.
ports.zhNote: South Fork Wind 的人員運輸船與換班直升機以昆塞特角為基地，Ørsted 在此設有運維中心（CTV Gripper 2024 年起停泊）；服務船停靠州有的戴維斯維爾港，Revolution Wind 的輸出海纜亦在此登陸。
farmsOther: Revolution Wind (export cable landfall at Quonset Point)
ports.coordNote: Port of Davisville, Quonset Point (OSM node 12208973065 'Port of Davisville', the NOAA water-level station on the port's pier, 41.6113, -71.4103); Ørsted's Operations Hub / CTV berth itself is not tagged.

ports.name: Nexans Charleston subsea cable plant (Goose Creek)
ports.zh: Nexans 查爾斯頓海纜廠（古斯克里克）
ports.en: Nexans' 2013 land-cable plant on the Cooper River became North America's first high-voltage subsea cable factory (opened 2021, up to 525 kV HVDC) where cable-laying vessels load out directly; it made the South Fork Wind export cable and holds deals with Ørsted/Eversource and Equinor's Empire Wind.
ports.zhNote: Nexans 2013 年的陸纜廠位於庫珀河畔，2021 年改造為北美第一座高壓海纜廠（最高 525 kV HVDC），鋪纜船可直接靠廠裝載；製造 South Fork Wind 輸出海纜，並與 Ørsted／Eversource 及 Equinor 簽有協議。
farmsOther: Empire Wind 1 and 2 (preferred supplier agreement, delivery not verified)
Ørsted/Eversource framework up to 1,000 km of cable to 2027
ports.coordNote: Nexans High Voltage Cable works on the Cooper River, Bushy Park industrial area, Goose Creek (OSM way 618045214 man_made=works, centre 32.9916, -79.9274); the plant's own load-out quay is not tagged.

ports.name: Port of Ramsgate
ports.coordNote: Commercial port basin (Port of Ramsgate, Military Road) west of the Royal Harbour; approximate, read from the map. London Array's O&M building is on Military Road (stakeholder notice).
ports.en: O&M port in Kent: London Array's operations base opened here in March 2012 (about 70 technicians, five vessels), and Vattenfall runs Thanet, Kentish Flats and Kentish Flats Extension from Ramsgate Harbour with about 70 staff; 320 turbines are serviced from the port.
ports.zhNote: 肯特郡運維港：London Array 運維基地 2012 年 3 月啟用（約 70 名技師、5 艘船），Vattenfall 亦在此運維 Thanet 與 Kentish Flats（約 70 人），共 320 部風機由此港服務。

ports.name: Port of Newhaven (East Quay)
ports.coordNote: East Quay on the east bank of the River Ouse in Newhaven harbour; approximate, read from the map (the O&M base and CTV pontoon are at East Quay per the opening report).
ports.en: Rampion's operations and maintenance base at Newhaven Port's East Quay (control room, offices, warehouse, quayside CTV pontoon, about 60 staff) opened in May 2018; the port had been the temporary construction base with crew transfer vessels from January 2016.
ports.zhNote: Rampion 風場運維基地位於紐黑文港東碼頭（控制室、辦公室、倉庫、人員運輸船浮橋，約 60 人），2018 年 5 月啟用；2016 年起即為施工期人員運輸船基地。

ports.name: Brightlingsea (Ørsted Gunfleet Sands base)
ports.coordNote: Brightlingsea waterfront on Brightlingsea Creek (Waterside); approximate, read from the map. The base stands on a former boatyard site; the exact plot was not identified.
ports.en: DONG Energy (now Ørsted) built an operations and servicing centre on a former boatyard in Brightlingsea, Essex, from which it runs O&M for Gunfleet Sands with Siemens; crew transfer and survey vessels for the wind farm work out of Brightlingsea.
ports.zhNote: DONG Energy（今 Ørsted）在艾塞克斯郡布萊特靈西的舊造船廠址建運維中心，與 Siemens 由此運維 Gunfleet Sands；人員運輸船與調查船也以此為基地。

ports.name: Harland & Wolff yard, Belfast Harbour
ports.zh: 貝爾法斯特港哈蘭沃夫船廠
ports.coordNote: Harland & Wolff shipyard on Queen's Island, Belfast Harbour (OSM landuse=industrial centroid); the quay used for Ormonde load-out was not identified. Distinct from the D1 terminal (gbr-belfast-d1) that opened in 2013.
ports.en: Harland & Wolff's Belfast shipyard received Ormonde's 30 REpower 5M nacelles, blades and tower sections from Germany and pre-assembled them in 2010–11; A2SEA's Sea Jack carried the turbines to the site off Barrow. Belfast's later offshore wind work moved to the D1 terminal.
ports.zhNote: 貝爾法斯特港哈蘭沃夫船廠 2010–11 年接收 Ormonde 的 30 部 REpower 5M 機艙、葉片與塔段並預組裝，由 A2SEA 的 Sea Jack 運往 Barrow 外海安裝；之後的離岸風電作業移往 D1 碼頭。

ports.name: Port of Zeebrugge (Albert II-dok)
ports.coordNote: Albert II-dok in the outer port of Zeebrugge (OSM harbour node); Van Oord's 175 m x 285 m storage and handling yard for Belwind was on this dock.
ports.en: Van Oord ran a storage and handling yard on the Albert II-dok for Belwind phase 1 (2009–10): monopiles and transition pieces were shipped to Zeebrugge, stored (20 of each), fitted out and floated out to the Bligh Bank; no later offshore wind use of the port is recorded here.
ports.zhNote: Van Oord 2009–10 年在 Albert II 船塢設 Belwind 一期的儲放與組裝場：單樁與轉接段運到澤布魯日（各可存 20 件）、組裝後浮運至 Bligh Bank；此港其他離岸風電用途不多。

ports.name: Klagshamn harbour (Vattenfall Lillgrund O&M base)
ports.coordNote: Small-craft harbour at the tip of the Klagshamn peninsula south of Malmö; approximate, read from the map. The O&M building's exact position was not identified.
ports.en: Vattenfall's O&M building for Lillgrund at Klagshamn (south of Malmö) was completed in summer 2008; the wind farm is run locally from Klagshamn by day (Esbjerg control centre at night) and Vattenfall's Lillgrund technicians are based there.
ports.zhNote: Vattenfall 的 Lillgrund 運維大樓位於馬爾默南方的 Klagshamn，2008 年夏完工；白天由 Klagshamn 就地運轉（夜間由 Esbjerg 控制中心），技師駐地亦在此。

ports.name: Helgoland Südhafen (RWE / WindMW service stations)
ports.coordNote: Südhafen (southern harbour) basin of Helgoland, where the RWE and WindMW service buildings stand (OSM way 562590248 'Südhafen', centre 54.1762, 7.8944)
ports.en: Offshore service island: RWE's service and operating station in the southern port, inaugurated Sept 2014, runs Nordsee Ost, Amrumbank West and Kaskasi (about 100 staff); WindMW's own station there has serviced Meerwind Süd/Ost since 2014.
ports.zhNote: 黑爾戈蘭島南港的離岸運維基地：RWE 服務站 2014 年 9 月啟用，運維 Nordsee Ost、Amrumbank West 與 Kaskasi（約 100 人）；WindMW 亦自 2014 年在此運維 Meerwind Süd/Ost。

ports.name: Port of Amsterdam (Westpoort: Amerikahaven / Alaskahaven)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: centre of the Amerikahaven basin (OSM), where the TMA Logistics terminal lies; the Alaskahaven used for Windplanblauw is about 1.3 km north (52.425, 4.764)
ports.en: Storage and transshipment base for IJsselmeer nearshore farms: Siemens Gamesa shipped all 89 Windpark Fryslân turbines from the TMA Logistics terminal in the Amerikahaven (2020–Oct 2021), and Windplanblauw's turbine parts and blades went to Lelystad from the Alaskahaven (2023–24).
ports.zhNote: IJsselmeer 近岸風場的儲運基地：Windpark Fryslân 89 部風機自 Amerikahaven 的 TMA Logistics 碼頭出港（2020–2021 年），Windplanblauw 的風機零件與葉片自 Alaskahaven 運往 Lelystad（2023–24 年）。

ports.name: Port of Harlingen (Industriehaven, KTF yard)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Industriehaven basin of Harlingen (OSM); the exact KTF 'Nesta' quay used was not identified
ports.en: Harlingen crane and transport firm KTF stored and transshipped the 89 concrete internal platforms for Windpark Fryslân's foundations (made by Aarsleff in Poland) on its Nesta site from Sept 2020, loading them onto pontoons for the IJsselmeer site.
ports.zhNote: 哈靈恩的 KTF 自 2020 年 9 月起在 Nesta 場地儲存並轉運 Windpark Fryslân 基礎用的 89 座混凝土平台（Aarsleff 波蘭製），再裝上浮駁運往 IJsselmeer 場址。

ports.name: Port of Urk
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Urk's harbour basin on the IJsselmeer (OSM, Havendienst Urk); the temporary Siemens site within the harbour was not identified
ports.en: Siemens' base port for managing construction of the 144 MW Westermeerwind nearshore farm (2015–16): temporary offices, cranes and a storage area in the harbour, used mainly for people and smaller parts; large components came from Vlissingen, Amsterdam and the Oude Zeug work harbour.
ports.zhNote: Siemens 興建 144 MW Westermeerwind 近岸風場（2015–16 年）的管理基地港：港內設臨時辦公室、起重機與堆場，主要運送人員與小件；大件自弗利辛恩、阿姆斯特丹與 Oude Zeug 工作港出發。

ports.name: Port-Joinville, Île d'Yeu (quai Vernier, EMYN O&M base)
ports.coordNote: Quai Vernier in Port-Joinville harbour (OSM road 'Quai Vernier'); the base is the former fish auction hall on that quay. Island port about 17 km off the Vendée coast: may need FAR_OK in qa_ports.py
ports.en: EMYN's (Ocean Winds) operations and maintenance base for the 61-turbine Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier farm: the former fish auction hall on quai Vernier (3,357 m², pontoon for crew transfer vessels), inaugurated 6 June 2025 and run by a team of 66.
ports.zhNote: EMYN（Ocean Winds）的 Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier 風場（61 部風機）運維基地：quai Vernier 舊魚市改建（3,357 平方公尺、附 CTV 浮橋），2025 年 6 月 6 日啟用，66 人團隊。

ports.name: Port of Hvide Sande
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Hvide Sande harbour basin on the Danish west coast (north harbour, Nordhavnskaj/Industrikaj area per OSM); the sources do not name the exact quay of Vattenfall's service hub.
ports.en: Vattenfall's Danish North Sea service hub: chosen in 2019 as the O&M base for Horns Rev 3 (service from 2024, after the MHI Vestas warranty) and in 2021 for Vesterhav Syd and Nord; the hub services 90 turbines (757 MW) with about 50 staff.
ports.zhNote: Vattenfall 丹麥北海運維基地：2019 年選為 Horns Rev 3 運維港（2024 年起），2021 年再納入 Vesterhav Syd 與 Nord，共服務 90 部風機、約 50 名員工。

ports.name: Port of Thyborøn
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Thyborøn harbour's offshore project quay area (OSM port node at Sperlingvej, southern harbour); the exact project quay used by DEME is not named in the sources.
ports.en: North Sea installation port at the Limfjord entrance: DEME's Innovation loaded the 41 monopiles and transition pieces for Vesterhav Nord and Syd here in 2023 (the project's marshalling port), and Siemens Gamesa ran its turbine-installation crew transfer vessels from the port.
ports.zhNote: 林姆峽灣口的北海安裝港：2023 年 DEME 的 Innovation 在此裝載 Vesterhav Nord 與 Syd 的 41 座單樁與轉接段，Siemens Gamesa 安裝風機的人員運輸船亦以此為基地。

ports.name: Port of Nyborg (ADP)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: ADP's commercial port at Lindholm on the east side of Nyborg (Great Belt); the sources name only 'the harbour in Nyborg', not the quay.
ports.en: Great Belt installation port used by A2SEA: the 72 Bonus turbines of Nysted were shipped from here four at a time in 2003 (18 round trips), and in 2010 the Siemens turbines for Rødsand II were shipped out from Nyborg.
ports.zhNote: 大貝爾特海峽的安裝港：2003 年 A2SEA 從此每趟載 4 部風機、18 趟運完 Nysted 的 72 部；2010 年 Rødsand II 的 Siemens 風機亦由此出貨。

ports.name: Port of Gedser
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Gedser harbour basin on the southern tip of Falster (ferry port); the sources name the port of Gedser but not the quay of the Ørsted service centre.
ports.en: Ørsted's service centre for the Nysted offshore wind farm (about 13 km west of Gedser): 22 local employees, with a crew transfer vessel taking technicians out daily (2023). A 2022 Ørsted decommissioning plan says the farm is operated from the port of Nysted, so the base may have moved.
ports.zhNote: Ørsted 的 Nysted 離岸風場運維中心（風場在 Gedser 西方約 13 公里）：2023 年有 22 名當地員工、CTV 每日出海；2022 年除役計畫寫的是從 Nysted 港運作，基地可能曾搬遷。

ports.name: Rødbyhavn (RWE service station)
ports.coordNote: Vestre Kaj 6, Rødbyhavn (RWE Renewables Denmark's address, geocoded on OSM); the service station sits on the western quay of Rødbyhavn harbour.
ports.en: RWE's service station for Rødsand 2 (207 MW, about 9 km south-east of the port): RWE is solely responsible for the daily O&M of the farm, with a team of about 25 based at Vestre Kaj 6; E.ON serviced the farm from here before RWE.
ports.zhNote: RWE 的 Rødsand 2 運維站（風場在港口東南約 9 公里）：RWE 負責全部日常運維，約 25 人以 Vestre Kaj 6 為基地；RWE 之前由 E.ON 在此維護。

ports.name: Le Havre (Siemens Gamesa blade and nacelle plant)
ports.zh: 勒哈佛港（Siemens Gamesa 葉片與機艙廠）
ports.coordNote: Siemens Gamesa plant on Avenue Lucien Corbeaux in the port of Le Havre (OSM via Nominatim, 49.4785, 0.132); distinct from the Fécamp foundation yard at Quai de Bougainville (fra-le-havre).
ports.en: Siemens Gamesa's Le Havre factory made and assembled the blades and nacelles of the 61 turbines (8.4 MW) of the Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier farm, delivered to Saint-Nazaire from December 2024 for pre-assembly.
ports.zhNote: Siemens Gamesa 勒哈佛廠製造並組裝 Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier 風場 61 部 8.4 MW 風機的葉片與機艙，2024 年 12 月起運往 Saint-Nazaire 預組裝。

ports.name: Haiyang Port
ports.coordNote: Approximate: OSM industrial area 海阳港 (36.678,121.240) in Fengcheng sub-district, Haiyang, Yantai; the quay the O&M crews use is not tagged.
ports.en: Port at Haiyang on the Yellow Sea coast from which the O&M crews of Huaneng's Peninsula South 4 offshore wind farm sail; the farm is about two and a half hours by boat (China Energy News, April 2024).
ports.zhNote: 海陽市黃海岸的港口，華能半島南4號風場的運維人員由此出海，航程約兩個半小時（中國能源報 2024-04）。

ports.name: Tan Cang - Cai Mep terminal (TCCT), Phu My
ports.coordNote: Approximate: OSM industrial area Cảng Cái Mép (10.510,107.016) on the Thi Vai river at Tan Phuoc ward, Phu My (formerly Ba Ria-Vung Tau, now Ho Chi Minh City); the TCCT berth itself is not tagged.
ports.en: Saigon Newport's Tan Cang - Cai Mep container terminal in the Cai Mep deep-water port area has handled wind-turbine import ships since 7 Sept 2020, when the SAL vessel Trina unloaded 89 packages of equipment for Bac Phuong's Dong Hai 1 (Bac Lieu) phase 2; later calls served onshore projects in the Central Highlands.
ports.zhNote: 西貢新港公司在蓋梅深水港區的貨櫃碼頭，2020 年 9 月 7 日起接卸風機進口船：首船 Trina 卸下薄寮東海 1 號二期的 89 件設備，之後多為中部高原陸域風場。

ports.name: Taisheng Blue Island yard, Qidong (Nantong)
ports.zh: 南通啟東（泰勝藍島海工廠）
ports.coordNote: Approximate, low confidence: OSM stop 蓝岛海工 (31.698,121.847) on the riverside road at Yinyang town, Qidong, Nantong (Nantong government: the company is in Qidong); the shipping source only says the monopiles left from Nantong.
ports.en: Offshore-structure yard of Nantong Taisheng Blue Island Offshore (TSP Blue Island, Shanghai Taisheng Wind Power's marine arm) at the Yangtze mouth in Qidong, Nantong; it shipped the first 31 monopiles for Vietnam's 310 MW Binh Dai project at the end of September 2020 and builds offshore substations, jackets and platforms.
ports.zhNote: 南通泰勝藍島海工（上海泰勝風能子公司）在啟東長江口的海工廠，2020 年 9 月底發出越南平大（Bình Đại）310 MW 專案的首批 31 根單樁，也製造海上升壓站、導管架與平台。
farms: Bến Tre 10 Bình Đại 1 Offshore wind farm

ports.name: Ningbo Orient Cable plant quay (Beilun)
ports.zh: 寧波北侖（東方電纜廠區碼頭）
ports.coordNote: Approximate: OSM industrial area 东方电缆 (29.861,122.086) at Guoju sub-district, Beilun, Ningbo; the plant's own quay is a few hundred metres from the works (Xinhua, Dec 2024).
ports.en: Submarine-cable plant of Ningbo Orient Cable (NBO) at Beilun with its own quay: the 35 kV array cables for phase one of Vietnam's Binh Dai wind farm were loaded onto the installation barge here in March 2021; later shipments include Yangjiang and Dutch export cables.
ports.zhNote: 寧波東方電纜北侖海纜廠，廠區旁有專屬碼頭：2021 年 3 月越南平大一期的 35 kV 陣列海纜在此裝上敷設駁船，之後也由此出運陽江與荷蘭的海纜。
farms: Bến Tre 10 Bình Đại 1 Offshore wind farm

ports.name: Port of Hartlepool (PD Ports, Victoria Harbour)
ports.coordNote: Hartlepool Dock / Victoria Harbour, PD Ports' enclosed dock (OSM harbour node 'Hartlepool Dock'); the exact wind-farm quay is not named in the sources
ports.en: PD Ports' enclosed dock at Hartlepool: construction logistics hub for EDF's Teesside wind farm in 2012-13 (all components and crews shipped from here, blades and hubs assembled on the quay) and since then the farm's O&M base with a 16-strong permanent team.
ports.zhNote: PD Ports 的哈特爾浦港：2012–13 年為 EDF Teesside 風場的施工物流基地（所有組件與人員自此出海，葉片與輪轂在碼頭組裝），之後為該風場的運維基地（16 名常駐人員）。

ports.name: Neptune dry dock, Wallsend (River Tyne)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: the former Swan Hunter Neptune Yard on the north bank of the Tyne at Wallsend (Neptune Road); the dry dock itself is not tagged in OSM
ports.en: BAM Nuttall built the five concrete gravity-base foundations for EDF's Blyth Offshore Demonstrator in the Neptune dry dock on the Tyne in 2016-17; they were floated down river and towed out for the world's first 'float and submerge' installation.
ports.zhNote: BAM Nuttall 於 2016–17 年在泰恩河 Neptune 乾塢建造 EDF Blyth 示範風場的 5 座混凝土重力式基礎，再浮運出河、拖至海上，為全球首次「浮運下沉」安裝。

ports.name: Port of Blyth (South Harbour)
ports.coordNote: Blyth South Harbour (OSM locality), the Port of Blyth terminal where EDF leased its O&M facility; the exact building is not identified
ports.en: Northumberland trust port: mobilisation base for EDF's Blyth Offshore Demonstrator (2017) and, under a 20-year lease at the South Harbour terminal, its long-term O&M base housing EDF and MHI Vestas technicians (nine-person team) since 2018.
ports.zhNote: 諾森伯蘭的信託港：EDF Blyth 示範風場的動員基地（2017），並以南港碼頭 20 年租約設立長期運維基地，2018 年起由 EDF 與 MHI Vestas 技師（9 人團隊）進駐。

ports.name: Norddeich harbour (Norden)
ports.coordNote: Hafen Norden-Norddeich (OSM harbour node); the CTV pier used for alpha ventus is not identified
ports.en: East Frisian ferry and fishing harbour that serves as the base port for alpha ventus crew transfer vessels: EWE's 2016 tender required the CTV to run between Norddeich and the test field, with a pier placed in Norddeich (base could move to Borkum on request).
ports.zhNote: 東弗里斯蘭的渡輪與漁港，為 alpha ventus 人員運輸船的基地港：EWE 2016 年招標要求船隻往返 Norddeich 與測試場並在此設置碼頭（必要時可改以 Borkum 為基地）。

ports.name: Barhöft harbour (Klausdorf, near Stralsund)
ports.zh: Barhöft 港（施特拉爾松德附近）
ports.coordNote: Hafen Barhöft (OSM marina node) on the Bodden coast north of Stralsund; EnBW's service building is in this small harbour
ports.en: Small harbour 18 km from Stralsund that is EnBW's service base and control centre for Baltic 1 (Germany's first commercial offshore wind farm): eight technicians sail daily by crew boat to the farm 16 km offshore.
ports.zhNote: 距施特拉爾松德 18 公里的小港，為 EnBW Baltic 1（德國第一座商業離岸風場）的服務基地與控制中心：8 名技師每日搭人員船前往 16 公里外的風場。

ports.name: Kårehamn harbour (Öland)
ports.coordNote: Kårehamn harbour basin on the east coast of Öland (OSM marina node); the O&M building's quay is not tagged
ports.en: Old fishing harbour on Öland's east coast, revitalised as the operations base from which the 48 MW Kårehamn wind farm (7 km offshore) has been operated and maintained since 2013, by E.ON, then RWE and from April 2026 Aneo.
ports.zhNote: 厄蘭島東岸的老漁港，2013 年起為 7 公里外 48 MW Kårehamn 風場的運維基地（E.ON、RWE，2026 年 4 月起為 Aneo），港口因此重獲生機。

ports.name: Port of Pori – Mäntyluoto harbour
ports.coordNote: Porin satama, Mäntyluoto harbour area (OSM industrial landuse); the quay used for the Tahkoluoto components is not named
ports.en: Port of Pori's Mäntyluoto harbour received and handled the blades (63 m, with Blue Water Shipping's handling kit) and the ten Siemens 4 MW nacelles for Suomen Hyötytuuli's Tahkoluoto offshore wind farm in April-May 2017 ahead of installation off Pori.
ports.zhNote: 波里港 Mäntyluoto 港區於 2017 年 4–5 月接收並處理 Suomen Hyötytuuli 的 Tahkoluoto 離岸風場葉片（63 公尺，Blue Water Shipping 提供搬運設備）與 10 部 Siemens 4 MW 機艙，隨後出海安裝。

ports.name: Copenhagen – former B&W shipyard dry dock, Refshaleøen
ports.zh: 哥本哈根 Refshaleøen 舊 B&W 船廠乾塢
ports.coordNote: Approximate: the old dry dock at the south end of Refshaleøen (former Burmeister & Wain yard, Refshalevej), Copenhagen harbour; the dock is not tagged in OSM
ports.en: The 20 concrete gravity foundations of Middelgrunden were cast in 2000 in the old dry dock of the former B&W shipyard on Refshaleøen in Copenhagen harbour (the dock held exactly 20), fitted with the lower tower sections and floated out to the shoal by crane barge.
ports.zhNote: Middelgrunden 的 20 座混凝土重力式基礎於 2000 年在哥本哈根港 Refshaleøen 舊 B&W 船廠乾塢澆築（乾塢剛好容納 20 座），裝上下段塔架後以起重駁船浮運至淺灘。

ports.name: Port of Kalundborg (Østhavnen)
ports.coordNote: Østhavnen, the east harbour of Kalundborg (OSM), which Vestas leased in 2009; the exact quay (quays 4-5 per the port director) is not tagged
ports.en: Vestas leased Kalundborg's whole Østhavnen from August to December 2009 to assemble and ship out the seven V90-3.0 MW turbines of Sund & Bælt's Sprogø wind farm, sailed fully assembled on a jack-up vessel down the Great Belt; chosen because assembled turbines cannot pass under the bridge.
ports.zhNote: Vestas 於 2009 年 8–12 月租下卡倫堡整個東港，組裝並出運 Sund & Bælt Sprogø 風場的 7 部 V90-3.0 MW 風機（整機立於自升式船上駛下大貝爾特海峽）；因組裝後的風機無法通過大橋而選址於此。

ports.name: Port of Halifax (Nova Scotia)
ports.zh: 哈利法克斯港（加拿大新斯科細亞）
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Richmond Terminals, the Port of Halifax breakbulk/project-cargo piers on the Halifax side (OSM pier node); the berth used by Vole au vent is not named in the sources
ports.en: Canadian staging port for the 12 MW CVOW pilot: the two monopiles and transition pieces (Rostock) and Siemens Gamesa turbine components (Esbjerg) were shipped to Halifax in April 2020, where Jan De Nul's jack-up Vole au vent loaded them in three round trips to the site off Virginia (May-June 2020), as the Jones Act kept a foreign vessel from loading in a US port.
ports.zhNote: 12 MW CVOW 試驗風場的加拿大集結港：2020 年 4 月兩座單樁、轉接段（羅斯托克）與 Siemens Gamesa 風機組件（埃斯比約）運抵哈利法克斯，Jan De Nul 的自升式船 Vole au vent 自此分三趟載往維吉尼亞外海安裝（2020 年 5–6 月）。

ports.name: Dayu wharf, Cangnan (Wenzhou)
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Dayu town, Cangnan county (OSM admin node 大渔镇 27.392,120.600); the crew-boat wharf itself is not tagged.
ports.en: Wharf at Dayu, Cangnan, from which Huaneng Zhejiang's O&M crews sail about 2.5 hours to the Huaneng Cangnan 2 offshore wind farm (connected Sept 2023); Huaneng runs a Cangnan O&M station and onshore metering station nearby.
ports.zhNote: 華能浙江清能運維人員自溫州蒼南大漁碼頭出發、航行約兩個半小時到華能蒼南 2 號海上風電場（2023 年 9 月併網）；華能在蒼南設有運維站與陸上計量站。

ports.name: Xiuyu port, Putian (Shanghai Electric Putian base)
ports.zh: 莆田秀嶼港（上海電氣莆田基地）
ports.coordNote: Approximate: Dongzhuang town on the Xiuyu peninsula (OSM admin node 东庄镇 25.254,119.032), where the Xiuyu port area and the Xiuyu Lingang industrial park lie; the Shanghai Electric plant and its quay are not tagged.
ports.en: Shanghai Electric Wind Power's Putian plant in the Xiuyu Lingang industrial park at Xiuyu port (built from March 2017, first offshore turbine off the line Dec 2018, 300 sets a year): 6-8 MW machines for the Putian farms (Pinghai Bay phase 2, Sanchuan's Pinghai Bay area F and Shicheng) and the first batch of 8 MW units in 2021.
ports.zhNote: 上海電氣風電莆田基地位於秀嶼港的秀嶼臨港產業園（2017 年 3 月動工、2018 年 12 月首台海上風機下線、年產 300 套），供應莆田各海上風場（平海灣二期、三川的平海灣 F 區與石城）6–8 MW 機組，2021 年首批 8 MW 機組出廠。
